name: Leaves Assigment
query:
SELECT
    t.employee        AS "Employee:Link/Employee:350",
    t.employee_name   AS "Employee Name::250",
    t.requests        AS "Requests:Int:90",
    t.days_taken      AS "Days Taken:Float:100",
    30                AS "Yearly Allowed:Int:110",
    30 - t.days_taken AS "Remaining:Float:100",
    t.first_from      AS "First From Date:Date:120",
    t.last_to         AS "Last To Date:Date:120"
FROM (
    SELECT
        la.employee,
        la.employee_name,
        COUNT(la.name)  AS requests,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN la.type = 'Half Day' THEN 0.5
                ELSE DATEDIFF(la.to_date, la.from_date) + 1
            END
        )               AS days_taken,
        MIN(la.from_date) AS first_from,
        MAX(la.to_date)   AS last_to
    FROM `tabLeaves Assigment` la
    WHERE la.docstatus = 1
      AND la.from_date >= %(from_date)s
      AND la.from_date <= %(to_date)s
    GROUP BY la.employee, la.employee_name
) t
ORDER BY t.employee_name
